title: The Puppet Stage Curtain
youtube_title: The Puppet Stage Curtain | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Teamwork is letting each person keep the part they do best.
summary: At a bakery kitchen before the early table, a puppet curtain that stuck unless two people lifted will go wrong if one person rushes. Sora and Lumen split it into two slow jobs, while Ms. Okonkwo only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
